title: Business Head
description:
**1. Strategy & Venture Building**

* Define the business strategy, growth roadmap and market-entry plan for Next Ventures.
* Identify target industries, customer segments, recruitment niches and service opportunities.
* Set the business model, pricing, revenue streams and competitive positioning.
* Build the venture from an early stage into a scalable, process-driven organisation.
* Take ownership of business performance and turn plans into measurable outcomes.

**2. Business Development & Revenue Generation**

* Independently identify, approach, negotiate with and acquire new clients.
* Build a pipeline through direct sales, networking, referrals, partnerships and industry relationships.
* Use the Webingo ecosystem to generate initial business while building an independent client acquisition engine.
* Develop relationships with founders, CEOs, CTOs, HR heads and decision-makers.
* Build and run sales strategies for recruitment, executive search, retained search and RPO, and explore contract staffing where commercially viable.
* Own the sales pipeline, revenue forecast, commercial negotiations and acquisition targets.

**3. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Business**

* Establish Next Ventures as a trusted recruitment partner, starting with IT, technology and digital talent.
* Oversee the full recruitment lifecycle, from client requirement to candidate joining and post-placement follow-up.
* Personally lead critical client mandates and close placements.
* Set up delivery processes, quality standards, turnaround benchmarks and client reporting.
* Build a mix of contingency, retained search, RPO and other recurring-revenue services.

**4. Financial Management & Profitability**

* Own the P&L, revenue targets, gross margins, operating costs, collections and profitability.
* Prepare budgets, forecasts and growth plans, and set fee structures and commercial terms.
* Track revenue per recruiter, cost per placement, average fee and collection cycles.
* Manage working capital carefully, since fees are often collected after the candidate joins.
* Provide monthly performance reports with corrective action plans.

**5. Team Building & Leadership**

* Build the initial team and expand it as the business grows.
* Recruit, train, mentor and manage recruiters, business development staff and operations support.
* Define roles, expectations and KPIs, and build a culture of ownership, accountability and execution.
* Develop future team leaders so the business does not depend on one person.

**6. Client Relationship Management**

* Build long-term client relationships and act as a trusted talent partner.
* Ensure timely communication, transparent reporting and consistent delivery.
* Handle escalations, commercial discussions, feedback and replacement commitments.
* Improve repeat business, retention, referrals and account expansion.

**7. Systems, Processes & Technology**

* Set up SOPs for sales, recruitment, candidate management and client servicing.
* Implement an ATS, recruitment CRM and candidate database.
* Create dashboards for mandates, pipelines, placements, collections and team performance.
* Use automation to improve productivity, and keep all client and candidate data within company systems.

**8. Marketing, Branding & Partnerships**

* Develop market positioning and work with the group marketing team on LinkedIn, thought leadership, case studies and employer branding.
* Build relationships with industry associations, startup communities, educational institutions and training institutes.
* Explore channel partnerships and referral arrangements that bring in qualified leads.

**9. Compliance & Governance**

* Ensure sound client agreements, fee terms, replacement policies and service commitments.
* Maintain confidentiality of client and candidate information.
* Coordinate with finance, legal and compliance advisors on employment, staffing and contractual requirements.
* Keep accurate business and financial records, and spot commercial and compliance risks early.

**Essential Requirements**

* 6–10 years of experience in recruitment, staffing, talent acquisition services or a related business.
* All-rounder experience: has handled the business end to end, not only operations or only sales. This covers sales, client acquisition, delivery, team management, finance and process building.
* Proven ability to personally win clients, close recruitment mandates and drive placements.
* Experience managing a recruitment desk, business unit, team or revenue target.
* Strong commercial understanding of pricing, gross margins, collections and profitability.
* Excellent communication in English and Hindi, both spoken and written.
* Authoritative, confident leadership presence that earns the respect of clients, team members and senior stakeholders.
* Intrapreneurial mindset: takes ownership, acts like an owner, makes decisions with limited supervision and builds from scratch.
* Strong negotiation and relationship-management skills, and comfort with targets and direct accountability.

**Preferred Experience**

* IT and technology recruitment, executive search or digital-sector hiring.
* Experience building a recruitment business, launching a new vertical or scaling an existing operation.
* Relationships with founders, CXOs, HR heads and businesses in Kolkata or eastern India.
* Exposure to retained search, RPO, contract staffing or HR consultancy.
* Experience with ATS platforms, recruitment CRM systems and reporting dashboards.

**Who Should Apply**

* Professionals who want to move beyond routine recruitment management and own a complete business.
* Leaders confident in acquiring clients personally instead of depending on a sales team.
* People who can work with limited initial resources and build systems from scratch.
* Those who understand the difference between revenue, profit and cash flow.
* Candidates willing to be accountable for results, make difficult decisions and learn quickly.

title: HR Associate, Engagement, Communications & Learning
description:
**Job Information**
-------------------

* Industry Administration
* Business Corporate
* Date Opened 10/13/2026
* Function Human Resource
* Job Type Full time
* Work Experience 1-3 years
* City Kolkata
* State/Province West Bengal
* Country India
* Zip/Postal Code 700135

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Description**

  

**1.****Employee Engagement & Events**

  

* Contribute ideas and support the development of innovative and inclusive engagement initiatives that enhance the employee experience.

* Plan, coordinate and execute employee engagement activities, celebrations and events.

* Develop event concepts, proposals, budgets and execution plans for management review and approval.

* Create presentations, engagement updates and dashboards for leadership reviews.

* Draft and circulate employee communications, including event invitations, teasers, announcements and other engagement collaterals.

* Coordinate with external vendors for quotations, negotiations, bookings and execution.

* Manage end-to-end event logistics, including venue, materials, vendors, employee participation and post-event closure.

* Anchor and host employee events, celebrations and engagement programs.

* Track participation, feedback and outcomes of engagement activities and maintain relevant records.

* Conduct surveys with employees and internal stakeholders to understand participation levels, gather feedback and identify opportunities for improvement.

  

**2.****Employee Onboarding**

  

* Support and coordinate for the onboarding process for new employees. Maintain onboarding checklist and proactively follow up on pending activities until closure as per TAT.

* Coordinate and track with relevant internal teams to ensure timely completion of pre-joining and joining formalities.

* Initiate and coordinate IT access and other employee access requirements through the relevant internal portals.

* Assist new employees with applications and requirements relating to meals, transport and other workplace facilities.

* Coordinate with HR, IT, HR Administration and other stakeholders to ensure a smooth joining experience.

* Address routine onboarding queries and escalate exceptions or issues wherever required.

  
  
  
  
  
  
  

**3.****Recruitment Coordination**

  

* Coordinate and schedule candidate interviews with hiring managers and interview panels.

* Manage interview calendars and ensure interviews are completed within defined timelines.

* Follow up with interviewers for timely assessment and submission of feedback.

* Assist the HR Manager to maintain recruitment trackers and monitor candidate movement across different stages of the hiring process.

* Coordinate candidate selection and track the workflow with internal team members till the appointment letter roll out.

* Maintain accurate candidate and interview-related documentation as per valid ID and Address proofs.

* Coordinate with candidates and internal stakeholders to ensure a professional and seamless candidate experience.

  
  

**4.****Learning & Development**

  

* Drive the organization's learning and development agenda aligned with business and workforce capability requirements.

* Own and manage learning operations, including Learning Management System (LMS) administration, governance, and learner experience.

* Implement annual learning calendars, learning roadmaps, and capability-building initiatives.

* Create and curate engaging learning content, assessments, knowledge resources, and digital learning experiences.

* Partner with business leaders and stakeholders to understand capability requirements and translate them into measurable learning solutions.

* Manage mandatory and regulatory training programs, ensuring compliance and completion tracking.

* Evaluate learning effectiveness through analytics, assessments, feedback, and business impact measures.

* Research, evaluate, and implement external learning solutions, platforms, certifications, and content providers.

* Prepare learning dashboards, reports, and insights to support decision-making and leadership reviews.

  
  

**Required Skills & Competencies**

  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate confidently with employees, candidates, vendors and leadership.

* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

* Ability to create professional presentations and present information effectively to management.

* Strong planning, coordination and organizational skills.

* Ability to independently manage projects and assignments from conceptualization through execution and closure.

* Strong follow-up skills with the ability to manage multiple activities and stakeholders simultaneously.

* Ability to work within defined timelines and deliver assignments with minimal supervision.

* Self-starter with a proactive, hands-on and solution-oriented approach

* Ability to address, anchor and engage employee and leadership gatherings.

* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.

* Good attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate trackers and documentation.

* Ability to coordinate and negotiate effectively with external vendors.

* Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work in a fast-paced environment.

* Preferred / Added Advantage

* Experience with online graphic-design platform for creating employee communication collaterals, event creatives and presentations.

* Familiarity with AI and productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot or similar platforms.

* Prior exposure to employee engagement, event management, onboarding, recruitment coordination or HR operations.

* Experience working in a IT/ITES or shared-services environment.

* Exposure to HRMS, recruitment or employee self-service platforms would be an added advantage.

  
  

### **Requirements**

  
  

**Role Overview**

  

We are looking for a proactive, energetic and execution-focused HR Associate to support and independently manage key activities across Employee Engagement, Onboarding and Recruitment Coordination.

The role requires strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to interact confidently with employees, leadership, candidates and external vendors. The ideal candidate should be a self-starter who can take ownership of assignments, manage multiple priorities and drive activities from planning through closure within agreed timelines.

**Qualification**

  

* Graduate in any discipline

* Valid experience of 1.5 to 3.5 years

  
  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

  

The role would suit someone who is energetic, articulate and comfortable being visible within the organization. The individual should enjoy interacting with people while also possessing the discipline required to manage trackers, follow-ups and process-driven HR activities.

The candidate should be equally comfortable creating an event proposal in PowerPoint, negotiating with a vendor, anchoring an employee event, coordinating a new joiner’s onboarding requirements, and following up with a hiring panel for interview feedback.

title: Executive IT
description:
**Job Title:** Executive IT

**Function:** Information Technology

**Reports to:** Manager – IT

**Location:** Kolkata

**Travel Required**:**25%** **þ** **50%** **75%**


**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The Executive / Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – IT is responsible for ensuring the availability, stability and day\-to\-day support of IT infrastructure and end\-user systems across operational and administrative locations within the assigned region. The role coordinates IT support activities, manages vendor service delivery, resolves infrastructure issues and ensures minimal disruption to business operations.


Working closely with Operations, Customer Service, Commercial, HR and Corporate IT teams, the role provides first and second\-level support for IT infrastructure, end\-user computing, hardware, software and network\-related issues while ensuring adherence to service levels, IT standards and information security requirements.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To provide reliable, responsive and efficient IT support across the assigned region by ensuring timely resolution of technology issues, effective vendor coordination, high system availability and uninterrupted business operations through proactive infrastructure support and adherence to IT governance standards.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Regional IT Operations Support**

* Provide day\-to\-day IT support across all operational and administrative locations within the assigned region, ensuring high system availability and minimal business disruption.
* Coordinate resolution of hardware, software, network and system\-related issues impacting business operations.
* Ensure operational locations receive timely IT support in accordance with defined service levels.
* Provide on\-site support for critical IT issues where remote resolution is not feasible.
* Support regional IT readiness for new branch openings, relocations, expansions and operational infrastructure changes.

**Incident \& Service Request Management**

* Manage IT incidents and service requests from logging through resolution, ensuring adherence to defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Prioritise and coordinate resolution of business\-critical incidents impacting operational continuity.
* Perform first\-level troubleshooting and coordinate with specialised support teams for second and third\-level issues.
* Track recurring incidents, identify root causes and recommend preventive actions.
* Maintain accurate incident documentation, escalation records and service request updates.

**End User Computing \& Infrastructure Support**

* Support end\-user devices including desktops, laptops, printers, handheld devices, scanners and other operational IT equipment.
* Coordinate installation, configuration and maintenance of approved hardware, software and peripheral devices.
* Ensure timely provisioning and replacement of IT equipment for employees and operational locations.
* Support connectivity, user access, system availability and peripheral device functionality across the region.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance activities to maximise infrastructure reliability and equipment uptime.

**Vendor Management \& Service Delivery**

* Coordinate and monitor regional IT support vendors to ensure timely and effective service delivery.
* Track vendor performance against agreed SLAs and escalate service gaps where required.
* Validate completion of vendor activities and ensure quality of work performed.
* Coordinate warranty repairs, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) and third\-party support activities.
* Build effective working relationships with vendor partners to ensure uninterrupted IT support across the region.

**IT Asset \& Inventory Management**

* Maintain accurate records of regional IT assets including desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, handheld devices and networking equipment.
* Coordinate asset allocation, movement, replacement and disposal in accordance with organisational policies.
* Support periodic IT asset verification and inventory audits.
* Ensure software licensing, asset tagging and documentation remain accurate and up to date.
* Monitor asset lifecycle and recommend timely replacement of ageing or obsolete equipment.

**Business Continuity \& Operational Readiness**

* Support business continuity by ensuring IT systems remain operational across all regional locations.
* Coordinate IT readiness for new operational sites, office relocations and infrastructure expansion projects.
* Participate in disaster recovery activities, system recovery testing and operational contingency planning where applicable.
* Ensure critical operational systems supporting logistics and customer service remain available with minimal downtime.
* Provide IT support during peak business periods and critical operational events to ensure uninterrupted business operations.

**Information Security \& IT Governance**

* Ensure compliance with organisational IT policies, information security standards and regulatory requirements across all regional locations.
* Support implementation of IT security controls, endpoint protection, user access management and system compliance initiatives.
* Coordinate timely installation of software updates, security patches and antivirus definitions in collaboration with Corporate IT and support vendors.
* Report IT security incidents, system vulnerabilities and policy deviations, ensuring timely corrective actions.
* Promote awareness of information security best practices among regional users.

**Cross\-functional Stakeholder Support**

* Partner with Operations, Customer Service, Commercial, Finance, HR and other business functions to understand IT support requirements and ensure timely service delivery.
* Coordinate with Corporate IT teams for system upgrades, application deployments, infrastructure enhancements and enterprise\-wide IT initiatives.
* Provide IT support for new branch openings, relocations, office expansions and operational infrastructure changes.
* Assist business users during rollout of new applications, hardware and technology solutions.
* Maintain effective communication with stakeholders regarding incident status, planned maintenance and system availability.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify recurring IT issues and recommend process improvements to enhance service quality and operational efficiency.
* Support implementation of new technologies, automation initiatives and digital solutions that improve business productivity.
* Recommend improvements to IT support processes, knowledge documentation and service delivery standards.
* Contribute to regional IT projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Foster a culture of customer service, collaboration, accountability, innovation and continuous learning.

  



**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, Computer Engineering or a related discipline is mandatory.
* Relevant technical certifications such as Microsoft, Cisco, ITIL, CompTIA or equivalent will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* **3–6 years** of experience in IT Infrastructure Support, End User Computing, Desktop Support or Regional IT Operations.
* Experience supporting multi\-location business operations within a regional environment.
* Strong experience in hardware troubleshooting, operating systems, user support and IT infrastructure coordination.
* Experience coordinating with outsourced IT support vendors and monitoring service delivery against agreed SLAs.
* Exposure to IT asset management, incident management, user access administration and IT support processes.
* Experience supporting logistics, transportation, warehousing, manufacturing, retail or other multi\-site organisations will be preferred.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* IT Infrastructure \& End User Support
* Hardware \& Peripheral Device Support
* Windows Operating Systems \& Microsoft Office
* Basic Network Troubleshooting
* IT Incident \& Service Request Management
* IT Asset \& Inventory Management
* Vendor \& SLA Management
* Active Directory \& User Access Management (preferred)
* IT Security \& Endpoint Compliance
* Microsoft Office Suite and IT Service Management (ITSM) tools

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Centricity
* Service Orientation
* Communication Skills
* Problem Solving \& Analytical Thinking
* Planning \& Coordination
* Stakeholder Management
* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Accountability \& Ownership
* Adaptability \& Learning Agility
* Integrity \& Professionalism
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

IT Service Delivery

  

Incident resolution within SLA, Service Request Closure TAT, System Availability

  

  

End User Support

  

User Satisfaction, First\-Time Resolution Rate, Reduction in Repeat Incidents

  

  

Vendor Performance

  

Vendor SLA Compliance, Timely Escalation \& Resolution, Quality of Service Delivery

  

  

IT Asset Management

  

Asset Accuracy, Inventory Compliance, Timely Asset Deployment \& Recovery

  

  

Infrastructure Support

  

Hardware Uptime, Preventive Maintenance Completion, Regional IT Readiness

  

  

Information Security

  

Compliance with IT Policies, Patch \& Antivirus Compliance, Security Incident Resolution

  

  

Business Support

  

IT Readiness for New Sites, Business Continuity Support, Stakeholder Satisfaction

  

  

Continuous Improvement

  

Process Improvements Implemented, Reduction in Recurring Incidents, Contribution to IT Projects


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**Disclaimer:**  

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.

title: HR Manager & Trainer
description:
**About Desun Academy:**


Desun Academy is the training and upskilling division of Desun Technology Pvt. Ltd., committed to preparing students and fresh graduates for successful corporate careers. We provide industry\-oriented training, live projects, placement assistance, and corporate exposure to bridge the gap between academics and industry.


**Job Summary:**


The HR Manager \& Trainer will be responsible for managing the complete Human Resource function for Desun Technology and Desun Academy while also delivering practical HR training to academy students. The role combines HR Operations, Talent Acquisition, Employee Engagement, Learning \& Development, and Student Training to build a high\-performing workforce and industry\-ready HR professionals.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


**A. Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment:**


* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for all business verticals.


* Understand manpower requirements from management.


* Prepare and publish job descriptions across hiring platforms.


* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, job portals, referrals, and social media.


* Conduct HR screening interviews and coordinate technical interviews.


* Schedule interviews and ensure proper candidate communication.


* Negotiate salary, release offer letters, and coordinate joining.


* Maintain recruitment MIS and hiring trackers.


* Ensure hiring targets are achieved within defined timelines.

* Create and maintain employee personnel files.


* Generate employment letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, experience letters, and relieving letters.


* Maintain HRMS records and employee database.


* Coordinate probation review and confirmation process.


* Manage attendance, leave records, and employee documentation.


* Support payroll preparation by ensuring HR data accuracy.

* Handle the complete employee lifecycle from hiring to exit.


* Monitor probation performance.


* Conduct employee feedback sessions.
